display_name: NIS2 Article 21 Gap Checker (Ten Cybersecurity Risk-Management Measures)
purpose: Check presence and maturity of all ten NIS2 Article 21(2)(a)–(j) cybersecurity risk-management measures. Derives per-measure maturity (0=absent, 1=documented-only, 2=implemented, 3=implemented+tested), aggregates to compliance score 0–100 and grade A–F, emits critical-gap list and prioritised remediation list. Consumes art-141 scope verdict; feeds penalty exposure calculator art-143.
